suites.title: Booking Management – API Testing
suites.description: Validation of RESTful Booker API endpoints, covering authentication, booking creation, update, and deletion workflows. Includes positive, negative, and edge case scenarios to ensure reliability and data integrity.

cases.title: [GET] Health - Ping
cases.description: Verify that the API is up and running.

steps.expected_result:
1. Status Code 201 Created.
2. Response time is below 1000ms.

cases.title: [POST] Auth - CreateToken
cases.description: Verify that the system generates a valid authentication token when correct admin credentials are provided. This token is required for PUT and DELETE operations.
cases.postconditions: The 'token' environment variable is updated with the new value.

steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Response body contains a valid "token" string \(length \> 0\)\.
3\. Token is successfully saved to the "token" environment variable\.

cases.title: [POST] Booking - CreateBooking
cases.description: Verify that a new booking can be created using a valid JSON payload. The system must return the created booking object and a unique Booking ID.
cases.postconditions: The 'bookingId' environment variable is captured and updated for future use.

steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Response body contains a unique "bookingid" \(number\)\.
3\. Validated Data: "firstname" is "Marcie" and "depositpaid" is true\.
4\. "bookingid" is successfully saved to environment variables\.

cases.title: [GET] Booking - GetBookingById
cases.description: Verify that specific booking details can be retrieved using a valid Booking ID. Ensures data consistency with the created record.
cases.preconditions: Requires a valid 'bookingId' stored in environment variables (from CreateBooking step).

steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Data Consistency: "firstname" is "Marcie" and "lastname" is "Jimenez"\.
3\. Date Validation: Checkin date matches YYYY\-MM\-DD format \(Regex\)\.
4\. Type Validation: "totalprice" is a valid number\.

cases.title: [PUT] Booking - UpdateBooking
cases.description: Verify that an existing booking can be fully updated. This operation requires a valid Auth Token.
cases.preconditions:
1. Valid 'bookingId' exists 
2. Valid 'token' exists (generated in Auth step).

steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Update Verified: "totalprice" is 200 and "additionalneeds" is "Full Update Test"\.
3\. Persistence Verified: "firstname" remains "Marcie"\.

cases.title: [PATCH] Booking - PartialUpdateBooking
cases.description: Verify that specific fields of an existing booking can be updated without affecting the rest of the data. Includes a regression check on unchanged fields.
cases.preconditions:
1. Valid 'bookingId' exists.
2. Valid 'token' exists (required for authorization).

steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Patched Fields: "firstname" is "Marcie QA"\, "lastname" is "Jimenez Master"\.
3\. Regression Check: "totalprice" remains 200 \(unchanged from previous state\)\.

cases.title: GET] Booking - GetBookingIdsByFilter
cases.description: Verify that the system returns the correct Booking IDs when filtering by "firstname" and "lastname".
cases.preconditions: A booking with Firstname="Marcie QA" and Lastname="Jimenez Master" must exist (created/updated in previous steps).

steps.action: Send GET request to {{baseUrl}}/booking?firstname=Marcie QA&lastname=Jimenez Master
steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Search Validation: Response is an Array with at least one item \(length \> 0\)\.
3\. Structure Check: The found item contains a "bookingid"\.

cases.title: [DELETE] Booking - DeleteBooking
cases.description: Verify that an existing booking can be deleted permanently. This operation requires a valid Auth Token.
cases.preconditions:
1. Valid 'bookingId' exists (to be deleted).
2. Valid 'token' exists (required for authorization).
cases.postconditions: The specific bookingId is invalidated/removed from the system.

steps.action:
Send DELETE request to {{baseUrl}}/booking/{{bookingId}}

Header: Cookie: token={{token}}
steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 201 Created\.
2\. Response Body: Text equals "Created"\.
3\. Performance: Response time is below 1000ms\.

suites.title: Trello Framework – API Workflow Testing
suites.description: Testing Trello API workflows with chained requests, focusing on board, list, and card management. Includes data validation and error handling scenarios.

cases.title: [GET] Auth - Check Credentials
cases.description: Verify that the API Key and Token are valid and allow access to the user's account.
cases.preconditions: Valid 'key' and 'token' must be configured in the environment variables.

steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Response contains User ID and Username\.
3\. Performance: Response time < 1000ms\.

cases.title: [POST] Boards - CreateBoard
cases.description: Verify that a new board can be created. The system must return a unique Board ID, which is captured for subsequent tests.
cases.postconditions: The 'boardId' environment variable is updated with the new Board ID.

steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Response body contains a valid "id"\.
3\. Automation: "boardId" is successfully saved to environment variables\.

cases.title: [POST] Lists - CreateList
cases.description: Verify that a new list (e.g., "To Do") can be created on the previously created board. Captures the List ID for adding cards.
cases.preconditions:
1. Valid 'boardId' exists (from CreateBoard step).
2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.
cases.postconditions: The 'listId' environment variable is updated with the new List ID.

steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Response body contains a valid "id"\.
3\. Automation: "listId" is successfully saved to environment variables\.

cases.title: [POST] Cards - CreateCard
cases.description: Verify that a new card can be created within a specific list. Includes performance checks and data integrity validation.
cases.preconditions:
1. Valid 'listId' exists (from CreateList step).
2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.
cases.postconditions: The 'cardId' environment variable is updated for future operations.

steps.action: Send POST request to {{baseUrl}}/cards?idList={{listId}}&name=My First Automated Card&key={{key}}&token={{token}}
steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Performance: Response time is below 800ms\.
3\. Data Integrity: "name" equals "My First Automated Card"\.
4\. Structure: Response contains a valid "id"\.
5\. Safety Check: Response does not contain "error" property\.
6\. Automation: "cardId" is successfully saved\.

cases.title: [PUT] Cards - UpdateCard
cases.description: Verify that an existing card can be updated (description and position). Includes regression checks to ensure the Card ID remains unchanged.
cases.preconditions:
1. Valid 'cardId' exists.
2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.

steps.action: Send PUT request to {{baseUrl}}/cards/{{cardId}}?desc=Updated description via API&pos=top&key={{key}}&token={{token}}
steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Data Validation: "desc" is updated to "Updated description via API"\.
3\. Position check: "pos" is not null\.
4\. Immutability Check: "id" matches the known \{\{cardId\}\}\.
5\. Safety: Response does not contain "error"\.

cases.title: [GET] Cards - GetCard
cases.description: Verify that card details can be retrieved. Ensures data persistence by validating that the description matches the previously updated value.
cases.preconditions:
1. Valid 'cardId' exists.
2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.

steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Data Persistence: "desc" equals "Updated description via API"\.
3\. Structure Check: Response contains "id" and "name"\.
4\. Data Validation: "name" is not empty\.

cases.title: [POST] Cards - AddComment
cases.description: Verify that a comment can be added to a specific card. Validates the nested response structure to ensure the text and creator details are correct.
cases.preconditions:
1. Valid 'cardId' exists.
2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.

steps.action: Send POST request to {{baseUrl}}/cards/{{cardId}}/actions/comments?text=Automation testing is fun!&key={{key}}&token={{token}}
steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Content Verification: "data\.text" matches "Automation testing is fun\!"\.
3\. User Verification: "idMemberCreator" is not null\.
4\. Structure: Response contains a valid "id"\.
5\. Sanity Check: Object is not marked as "deleted"\.

cases.title: [POST] Checklists - CreateChecklist
cases.description: Verify that a checklist can be added to a card. Validates the name, the association with the parent card, and that it is initially empty.
cases.preconditions:
1. Valid 'cardId' exists.
2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.

steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Data Verification: "name" equals "QA Tasks"\.
3\. Relationship Check: "idCard" matches the environment variable \{\{cardId\}\}\.
4\. Initial State: "checkItems" is an empty array\.

cases.title: [DELETE] Cards - DeleteCard
cases.description: Verify that a specific card can be deleted individually using its ID.
cases.preconditions:
1. Valid 'cardId' exists
2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.
cases.postconditions: The specific card is removed from the board.

steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Operation Check: Response confirms successful deletion \(Body is OK/Null\)\.
3\. Performance: Response time is below 800ms\.

cases.title: [DELETE] Boards - DeleteBoard
cases.description: Verify that the board is permanently deleted. This action cascades and removes all lists and cards contained within.
cases.preconditions:
1. Valid 'boardId' exists.
2. Valid 'key' and 'token' are configured.
cases.postconditions: The Board and all its contents are removed from the account.

steps.expected_result:
1\. Status code is 200 OK\.
2\. Response Validation: Body contains property "_value"\.
3\. Performance: Response time is below 2000ms\.
